limitations.summary: While the use of synthetic data allows us to objectively assess model performance, generalization to in vivo data remains to be tested, as there are several eﬀects in vivo that are currently not modeled by our pipeline, such as Rician noise, non-Gaussian diﬀusion, flow, or Magnetization Transfer.
items: While the use of synthetic data allows us to objectively assess model performance, generalization to in vivo data remains to be tested, as there are several eﬀects in vivo that are currently not modeled by our pipeline, such as Rician noise, non-Gaussian diﬀusion, flow, or Magnetization Transfer.

Furthermore, the identifiability of multi-compartment diﬀusion tensors from multi-shell acquisitions with linear b-tensors is limited: it has been shown that infinitely many compartment configurations produce identical single-shell signals, and that an extension to multiple b-values only reduces but does not eliminate this degeneracy [42,20].
However, further reduction of required contrasts is needed to allow clinical application. 5
